name: Key Largo Kampground & Marina
note: Condominium kampground: owners hold all 171 lots, about 38 of which the association rents by the night (2026 park map), and reviewers describe the rest as mostly full-timers and seasonal owners. The pool was closed for repairs (operator site, 2026-10-30). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site keylargokampground.com and its Campspot engine (campspot.com/book/keylargokampground; legal name Key Largo Kampground & Marina Condominium Association, Inc.) read 2026-10-30: the association itself sells single nights online on 'RV Non Water Front Back-in', 'Pull Through' and 'RV Waterfront Full Hookup' sites, full hookups, 35-40 ft max, motorhomes allowed, 7-16 sites free per type on Nov-Dec 2026 and Apr-Jul 2027 weeknights; the 2026 park map marks ~38 of 171 full-hookup RV lots as 'Rental Full Hook-Up'; minimum stay applies only to holidays and lobster mini season; no application, lease or waitlist; Google Maps open, phone, 4.2/1,245 -> real transient RV park inside an owner-lot condo park (held for AWH under the owner-lot rule); price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py) Owner-lot condo resort admitted under AWH 2026-10-30: 'Florida Keys owner lot resorts that rent spots by the night are ok if they have a normal booking site which works like a regular nightly campground' - the association's own Campspot engine sells single nights with no application.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's 2026 park map (keylargokampground.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Key-Largo-Map.png) runs lots 56-75 and 90-106 along both banks of a no-wake boat channel ('Channel To Ocean') with a dock at every lot, and lots 76-89 around the marina basin. The Campspot engine sells 'RV Waterfront Full Hookup' sites 057, 060, 071-074, 077, 079 and 085, all on that channel or basin per the map. Esri World Imagery (sat.py, 220 m frame at 25.1130,-80.4152, rendered and read) shows the channel lots backing straight onto the seawall with small docks and boats tied alongside, a few metres from the water with no road, lot or treeline between. The channel (~30 m wide) opens at the park's South Beach directly into South Creek, the tidal mangrove creek that reaches the Atlantic ~2.5 km SE (1.5 km-half-width frame at 25.108,-80.410, rendered and read). Salt tidal water, so I used bayfront, as for the Kings Kamp marina channel. The other ~29 rental lots (1-35, 109-166 and the loops) sit inland among other lots, so only the channel and marina rows are on the water. Label settled 2026-10-30 (Claude, reviewing): the pads face a ~30 m dredged channel into South Creek, not open bay, so under the size rule (roughly 30 m+ = river, Lakeport 14424) this is riverfront, not bayfront.
fees_source: campspot.com/book/keylargokampground site pages read 2026-10-30, 2 adults, no pets, 1 night Tue 2026-12-08: RV Non Water Front Back-in $120.00 x 1 night, Pull Through $125.00, RV Waterfront Full Hookup $156.00, before tax ($15.00 tax on $120). The engine's per-night average for these types is the same on Jan, Feb, Mar, May and Jul 2027 weeknights ($128.17 / $133.51 / $166.62 including fees), so $120 is the year-round base. Holiday weeks cost more: back-in $144 on 2026-11-10 (Veterans Day) and 2026-12-29. The only per-night 'Campground Fees' are pets ($20/night in the engine; $10 a pet per stay on the operator's policy page) and a 3.7% credit-card fee. There is no resort or grounds fee, and Campspot adds its own booking fee (~3.6%).

booking.note: 3-night minimum over MLK Day, Easter, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Eve, and over lobster mini season. Check-in guest must be 25+ (the Campspot terms say 21). Walk-ins 6-10 pm through the security guard, subject to availability.

flags: Rental program size: the 2026 park map marks about 38 of its 171 lots with the 'Rental Full Hook-Up' dot (17 in the southern loops, 21 along the channel and marina; my count from the map image). The Campspot engine offered up to 12 back-in + 16 pull-through + 9 waterfront = 37 RV sites. That is about 22%, which passes the 1-in-10 test. A 2025 resale listing says an owner's lot was 'enrolled in the campground's rental program' and earned about $125-150 a night.

Year-round owners: the association publishes no count. Campendium reviewers wrote 'almost the entire property are fulltime residents' (4/2023) and 'Mostly a mobile home park with a few rentable RV spots' (11/2021), and a Campspot reviewer wrote 'Lots of full timers but spots for weekend warriors' (3/2026). Satellite shows most owner lots built up with roofed structures, decks and carports. MHVillage lists the association as a mobile home park with 0 sites given. I found no evidence of mobile homes outnumbering RV lots; the map labels every lot 'Full Hook-up RV'.

Owner approval or application: none for a traveller. Campspot sells a single night outright, with a $250 card hold for incidentals and no application, lease or waitlist. Lots are deeded condo units sold by owners through realtors (one 2025 listing at $285,000), not by the park.

Winter availability: no RV site of any type was free on the Jan 5-7, Jan 12, Feb 9, Feb 9-12 and Mar 9 2027 weeknights, nor for a Jan 12-Feb 12 month, though the engine still prices them. Nov-Dec 2026 and Apr-Jul 2027 had 7-16 free per type. No monthly-only or long-minimum rule is published anywhere, so this looks like the rental lots selling out (or owners using them) in peak season, not a rule. Test 3 passes on what is published.

In-season cheapest is $120 before tax (back-in, Dec 2026, unchanged Jan-Apr 2027 list price), plus a 3.7% credit-card fee on card payments. The Military discount is a Campspot promo; Good Sam directory: CONDO_PARK, not a Good Sam Park, military=true.

Google 4.2/1,245 and Campspot 4.3/112 verified stays. That is not poor. Complaints I saw were a site switch at check-in (2/2026) and 'expensive, like everything in the Keys' (Campendium 1/2026). A 4/2023 reviewer with a 36-ft fifth wheel found the site very tight. I would add if AWH accepts owner-lot parks with an association-run rental program.

Waterfront value: on-water is solid (pads at the seawall with docks). I labelled it bayfront because the water is salt and tidal, as at Kings Kamp. The channel actually opens into South Creek, a mangrove tidal creek, not a bay, so riverfront (canal >=30 m wide, the Lakeport 14424 rule) is the alternative label if AWH prefers.
Pets: RV sites only, 2 max, 50 lb each, with a breed ban list. Pool closed for repairs as of 2026-10-30.
Converted from hold to add on AWH's 2026-10-30 owner-lot rule (association-run Campspot engine).
